answer: Work-slot deposit burn: an agent stakes 100 credits to claim one work slot, refunded after honest work. Verification splits claims through a prism of checks — past-work record, deposit proof, heartbeat — so a copy fails one facet. Forging 1,000 slots costs 1,000 x 100 = 100,000 credits, burned on failure; each fake climbs that knoll alone. The kernel is one verified history per deposit. An honest agent pays once and keeps the reward, undiluted.
